mcq.QUESTION_DESC: Which of the following is an advantage of Booth’s algorithm over basic shift-and-add multiplication?

sq.ANSWER:
• Fewer additions/subtractions for sequences of 1s in the multiplier.

  • Handles signed numbers directly using 2’s complement representation.

  • Reduces overall computation time for certain patterns of multipliers.
